Survey research for NGOs and research organisations

Source: vignettes/articles/learn/for-research-organisations.Rmd
for-research-organisations.Rmd

This page is for an NGO or research organisation planning its own survey research. It keeps the questionnaire, the analysis decisions and the report for stakeholders in 1 connected record.

Your steps

  1. Set up. Install R, RStudio and surveyframe as the Get started page shows.
  2. Start from an example. The questionnaire templates include customer satisfaction, employee engagement and decision-making studies to adapt.
  3. Prepare the pre-analysis plan. Record each research question, the measurements and the method on the Plan screen, then export the plan from the Report screen. The analysis plan explains each part.
  4. Collect responses your way. The Collect screen gives you a survey web page to host, and an optional collector that stores each response in a Google Sheet your organisation owns.
  5. Document decisions. A change to the plan after collection starts is recorded as an amendment with its reason.
  6. Report to stakeholders. Export the APA 7 report as HTML, Word, PDF or OpenDocument. It presents the planned analyses, the results, your interpretation and the recorded amendments.
